subject: Concord expansion — project matrix & staggered API key plan
messages:
From: Beth Carver <beth@concordsys.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@concordsys.com>, Concord Procurement <procurement@concordsys.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:15:00Z
Subject: Expanding to 6 new projects — timeline & provisioning questions

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Leadership greenlit expanding Redwood to cover six additional internal projects across two business units (Customer Insights + Field Ops). Before we lock dates, procurement asked for: a short SOW, an updated pricing sheet for multi-project pricing (we're exploring Dedicated vs Hosted uplift), and a recommended provisioning timeline for staggered rollout (we plan to onboard teams in waves to avoid change fatigue).

Two other asks from our side:
- API key provisioning: can you share how keys are segmented per project/app and whether we can have separate billing buckets per BU?
- Security artifacts: Bob from IT will ping your security team for a SOC-2 excerpt and network diagram.

Preferred start window: mid-April. Can you confirm next steps and attach the SOW/pricing?

Best,
Beth
Beth Carver
Head of Integrations, Concord Systems


From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Beth Carver <beth@concordsys.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@concordsys.com>, Concord Procurement <procurement@concordsys.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T13:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Expanding to 6 new projects — timeline & provisioning questions

Thanks Beth — great news, congrats to you and the team.

High level proposal (attached: Concord_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix-q2.xlsx):
- Phased rollout: Pilot (2 apps, 2 weeks) -> Phase A (3 apps, staggered over 3 weeks) -> Phase B (1 app + final cutover). We recommend a pilot to validate prompts and KV caching patterns.
- API keys & billing: we can provision separate API keys per project and tag usage to BU-level billing buckets. If you prefer one central key with role-based restrictions we can do that too.
- Capacity: suggest initial Dedicated reservation for Pilot (1x DGX-equivalent pool) with autoscale burst for Phase A. If you want strict cost controls, we can keep you on Hosted with higher concurrency limits while evaluating Dedicated.

Next steps I can take this week:
1) Set a 30-min planning call with our onboarding lead to confirm owners and SLOs.
2) Share SOW and pricing (attached) for legal/procurement.
3) Kick off security exchange with your IT contact.

Proposed meeting slots: Thu 2027-04-02 15:00 ET or Fri 2027-04-03 10:00 ET. Which works?

I'll also loop in our Onboarding PM and Capacity team after you pick a slot.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-415-555-0123

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T14:10:00Z
Subject: Internal: Concord Systems expansion — capacity & commercial ask

Team — Concord is expanding to six additional projects across two BUs; they prefer mid-April start and want a phased rollout. High-level asks below, can you confirm feasibility and requested artifacts by EOD tomorrow?

Quick asks:
- Capacity forecast input: what baseline Dedicated reservation would you recommend for Pilot -> Phase A scale? (I called out 1x DGX-equivalent for pilot above as a placeholder)
- Discount/price: procurement wants multi-project pricing; any standard expansion discounts for +6 projects (15% example) if they commit to a quarterly reserved spend?
- API key provisioning: process for issuing separate keys per project and tagging for BU billing. Are there rate-limit or IAM considerations if we issue 6 separate keys?
- Onboarding slots: PM availability week of 2027-04-11 for hands-on sessions.

Attached: capacity-forecast-request.xlsx (blank sheet with token patterns). I'll put Concord's preliminary volumes in after we sync.

Thanks — Rafael

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: Concord Systems expansion — capacity & commercial ask

Rafael — quick answers while I pull a formal quote:

- Capacity: Pilot @ 200k tokens/hour (1 small Dedicated pod) is safe. Phase A (up to 4 apps concurrently) we'd recommend bumping to 750k tokens/hour (2x small pods or 1 medium) with autoscale burst.
- Commercial: we can offer a 12% expansion discount for a 3-month commit on the additional projects; 15% if they commit to a quarterly reserved spend > $60k/month.
- Keys: we can issue separate keys per project and tag them to BU billing. Rate-limits are per-key by default; we can set custom rate limits per key and also issue IAM-scoped keys for read-only vs admin actions.
- PM: onboarding team has 2027-04-12 and 2027-04-14 afternoon slots open for workshops.

I'll follow up with a formal quote and a proposed SOW amendment tomorrow.

— Hannah
Director, Customer Success (Onboarding)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Beth Carver <beth@concordsys.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@concordsys.com>, Concord Procurement <procurement@concordsys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T16:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Expanding to 6 new projects — timeline & provisioning questions

Beth — following up with a consolidated plan and the next steps so your team has a single thread to share with procurement. Please see the short summary below and the two attached artifacts (Concord_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix-q2.xlsx).

Summary & recommended path:
- Pilot (2 apps): 2027-04-12 to 2027-04-23 — small Dedicated reservation (200k tokens/hr).
- Phase A (3 apps): 2027-04-26 to 2027-05-14 — scale to 750k tokens/hr (2 small pods), staged onboarding over first two weeks.
- Phase B (1 app): final cutover week of 2027-05-17.
- Commercial: 12% expansion discount included in attached pricing. If Concord signs a quarterly reserved spend >= $60k/month we can increase to 15% and guarantee steady-state capacity.
- API keys: we will provision separate keys per project and tag them per BU; billing buckets supported. IAM-scoped keys and per-key rate limits available on request.

Requested items from Concord to get started:
1) Signed SOW (attached).
2) Point of contact for security artifacts exchange (SOC-2 excerpt + network diagram).
3) PO or purchase terms to issue first invoice for reserved pilot capacity if they choose Dedicated.

We can run a 30-min kickoff Thursday 2027-04-08 at 10:00 ET to lock owners and workshop the pilot prompts. Here is a quick scheduling link: https://cal.example.com/rafael/concord-kickoff

If procurement prefers DocuSign, we've prepared the SOW for signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef1234567890

Thanks — excited to ramp Concord quickly.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
